hypothesis: A compact point-in-time-safe vector of prior FTN scheme/process state contains incremental home-win probability information conditional on the contemporaneous historical market benchmark.
decision_horizon: pregame; for every target game, only prior-game FTN rows with date_pulled earlier than that target game's modeled pregame decision timestamp are eligible
prohibited: FTN rows whose date_pulled is after the tested game's decision horizon
market-source timing represented as T-120 when only late/closing historical market is actually available

team_game_feature_definitions.off_motion_rate: mean is_motion on offensive plays with non-null charting
team_game_feature_definitions.off_play_action_rate: mean is_play_action on charted offensive pass/dropback plays
team_game_feature_definitions.off_rpo_rate: mean is_rpo on charted offensive plays
team_game_feature_definitions.off_screen_rate: mean is_screen_pass on charted offensive pass plays
team_game_feature_definitions.off_qb_out_of_pocket_rate: mean is_qb_out_of_pocket on eligible offensive dropbacks
team_game_feature_definitions.off_interception_worthy_rate: mean is_interception_worthy on eligible pass attempts
team_game_feature_definitions.def_blitz_rate: mean indicator n_blitzers > 0 while defending on eligible opponent dropbacks
team_game_feature_definitions.def_mean_pass_rushers: mean n_pass_rushers while defending on eligible opponent dropbacks
team_game_feature_definitions.def_mean_box_count: mean n_defense_box while defending on eligible charted plays

pregame_state.aggregation: team-level EWMA of completed eligible prior games
pregame_state.shift: one completed game before the target game
pregame_state.matchup_representation: home minus away for each of the exactly ten predeclared state variables
pregame_state.missingness: prior-season training median learned inside each walk-forward training fold plus an explicit missing indicator per feature family; no future-season imputation statistics

models.market_only_calibration: L2 logistic regression on historical market logit, fit only on prior seasons
models.market_plus_ftn: L2 logistic regression on historical market logit plus exactly the ten FTN matchup differences and predeclared missing indicators
models.regularization: C=0.1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=5000; fixed before results
models.feature_scaling: training-fold standardization for FTN feature columns only; market logit remains on logit scale

benchmarks: existing v0.8/F-ST research outputs as descriptive context only when samples align
primary_metric: Brier score delta: market_plus_ftn minus walk-forward market_only_calibration

qualification_rule.probability_quality: Brier must improve market-only calibration with a season+week blocked 95% interval excluding zero in the favorable direction; log loss may not show statistically supported degradation.
qualification_rule.stability: point improvement should not be driven by one target season with sign reversal in the others
qualification_rule.coverage: date_pulled eligibility and missingness must be reported; no target season may silently use later charting
qualification_rule.production_effect: none regardless of historical result; any next step requires a separate shadow preregistration and user authorization

rejection_rule: If primary qualification fails, record rejection and do not rescue via alternate C values, feature subsets, transformations, interactions or model families within this experiment.
